book.name: Maliku
book.title: Saaka wù joŋe kune Jiso no Maliku gɛ̀ Saŋ

content: Ŋgaŋ kune muh wù gɛ̀ nooŋ ŋgo
Jiso ka wu kɛ wu yɛyi bamii mbebe mamasi le, kinchvu ki bamii taashɛ fo nɛ gɛmm. Wu mo wu ja wu lee wu shii nyu a ŋguh le a joo, kinchvu kiyu lɛme ŋgɛɛme yi joo le kwa.
Wu tu wu yɛyi bo bɛ mwɛɛ wesee a baŋgaŋ le. Wu ja wu ma ŋgaŋ wumu bo le lɛ,

content.text: “Bɛŋ yêgɛ bɛŋ yû, muh gɛ̀ la ki wu gɛ̂ɛŋ wu noŋ ŋgo.
Wu gɛ̀ doo wu nooŋ, yimi gwe a je, munyii to mu tajɛ mu ji.
Yimi ŋgo gwe fɛ kijusɛ ki kimbaaŋ le nshɛŋ nyu gɛ fo chuule gɛ. Yi mo yi yaŋsɛ yi bu nje nshɛŋ gɛ̀ bee fo gɛh nɛ shige.
Muu doo wu kɛ wu baaŋ, wu suŋ ŋgo yiyu yi bobɛ, nje yi gɛ̀ baaŋ a chimɛ gɛ gɛŋ gɛ.
Yimi ŋgo gwe yi mbiaŋ le. Mbiaŋ yiyu kuu yi mo yi baŋɛ ŋgo yiyu, yi gɛ yuŋ muntaŋ gɛ.
Yimi gwe nyu yi nshɛŋ yì joŋe le, yi gɛ̀ bu, yi kuu yi yuŋ, yi duu yi fe no ba gɛ̀ noŋ, jise chi ŋgo yune ajii mbaanshɛ, yimi ajii mbambvusoo, yimi ajii gwii.”

content: No Jiso ma noo wu mo wu mɛsɛ lɛ,

content.text: “Muh wù kɛme bintuŋ wu yu.”

content: Le nje la fì Jiso gɛ̀ jɛme nyu a baŋgaŋ le
Jiso gɛ̀ doo wu nyume wumaa, bamii bamu ba bɛ bo gɛ̀ bee mo booŋ be ba ŋgoo ba yuufe ncho bafɛɛ biih wu le kune ŋgaŋ wuyu.
Wu chvuu bo le lɛ,

content.text: “Le bɛŋ ba Nyo le wu dunyɛ wa kinyilɛ ki bvunfoŋ bwe bɛŋ le. Geenɛ, fɛ bamii bamu le fiɛɛ fichii le nyu a baŋgaŋ le,
wu lɛ bo ge bo jiiŋe, geenɛ bo ya yɛde gɛ, bo ge bo yege, bo ya yuge gɛ. Fi nɛ bee gɛ noo gɛ tu bo bee bo kusɛ wa muntele muboo, Nyo lɛɛshɛ bimbefɛ biboo.”

content: Fiɛɛ fì ŋgaŋ wu Jiso gɛ ma duunyi
Jiso ja wu biih bamii ba gɛ̀ bee bɛ wu le lɛ,

content.text: “Fi le lɛ bɛŋ baaŋ kɛɛ gɛ fiɛɛ fì ŋgaŋ wunɛ jɛme gɛ? Nɛ bɛŋ baaŋ kɛɛ gɛ wunɛ gɛ, bɛŋ lé bɛŋ gê nɛɛ fɛ bɛŋ kɛɛ baŋgaŋ bamu?
Ŋgo yì muh wuyu gɛ̀ noŋ le jɛ yi Nyo.
Ŋgo yì gɛ̀ gwe a je le bamii ba yuge jɛ yi Nyo, Sataŋ mo wu to kimimia wu bvusɛ jɛ yiyu fɛ muntele muboo le.
Ŋgo yì gɛ̀ gwe fɛ kijusɛ ki ata le, le bamii ba yuge jɛ yi Nyo, bo fi lo kimimia bɛ njoŋ,
geenɛ, yi baaŋ a chimɛ gɛ gɛŋ fɛ muntele muboo le gɛ. Yi lɛme gɛh nɛ shige, nɛ ŋgɛ le wu to, kɛnɛ bamii boone nyu bikaa a bo jiŋ nje jɛ yiyu, bo mo bo chii bikaa kimimia.
Ŋgo yì gɛ̀ gwe mbiaŋ le, le bamii ba yuge jɛ yi Nyo,
nfuuŋsɛ kune mwɛɛ mu yi woŋ kfunɛ le, bɛ kiŋkoŋɛ ki bvukugɛ mo kiŋkoŋɛ ki mwɛɛ munɛ, mo mu taashɛ mu baŋɛ jɛ yiyu yi laayɛ lo achiji.
Ŋgo yì gɛ̀ gwe yi nshɛŋ yì joŋe le, le bamii ba yuge jɛ yi Nyo, bo fi, bo gee no yi goone bo gɛɛne lo fwe fwe, gɛh njɛ fɛ ŋgo yì yuŋ ajii mbaanshɛ, yimi ajii mbambvusoo, yimi ajii gwii.”

content: Kune kin'yesɛ
Jiso ja wu biih lɛ,

content.text: “Muh to wu lee bɛ kin'yesɛ yeh wu kfuusɛ bɛ ŋkaa, kɛnɛ wu leesɛ agaguu? Gɛ muh to wu chu wu tome nyume yi fiɛɛ fì ba to ba toome kin'yesɛ fo gɛ?
Bɛŋ kêe lɛ fiɛɛ fichii fì le nyilɛ le, le ba gɛ̀ nyile lɛ ba ge fi yɛnɛ, fì le ajiŋ ajiŋ fichii ba lé ba gê fi bu fɛ waaŋ.
Muh wù kɛme bintuŋ, wu yu.

content: Jiso ka wu jɛmɛ lɛ,

content.text: “Bɛŋ doo bɛŋ yege jɛ yi Nyo bɛŋ yêge chuule, bɛŋ kêe lɛ je yì muh yege yu le yì Nyo lé wu gê wu fe yo, fɛ wu nya mwɛdɛ le. Wu lé wu gê wu nya noo wu fesɛ lo.
Muh wù kɛme fiɛɛ, lé ba nyû ba bisɛ. Muh wù kɛme gɛ fiɛɛ gɛ mo nyu fì shige fì wù kɛme, lé ba nyû ba ge ba fi lo a wu le.”

content: Ŋgaŋ kune ŋgo no yi to yi kuu
Jiso ka wu jɛmɛ lɛ,

content.text: “Bvunfoŋ bvu Nyo le njɛ ŋgo fɛ muh nooŋ mwɛne.
Doo nyume antaŋ wu tu wu lefe, akfuuŋ yuu wu ja we. Ŋgo yiyu gɛ̀ bu yi tu yi kuu, wu baaŋ a kɛɛ gɛ laa yi gee nɛɛ fɛ yi kuu la,
gee gɛh nshɛŋ fɛ yi kuu. Sege yi ja yi chooŋ, yi ja yi faashɛ, yi ge yi ja fo yi tuŋ ajii.
Yi doo yi ta, wu mo wu jo finyoo wu lee mwɛne, nje kife ki ŋgwejɛ le ki kojɛ ka.”

content: Ŋgaŋ kune kfuu chi ŋgo yi fintaŋ fimi
Jiso ka wu ja wu jɛmɛ lɛ,

content.text: “Taŋlo besabɛŋ fe bvunfoŋ bvu Nyo bɛ la? Taŋlo besabɛŋ fe bɛ ŋgaŋ wù la?
Bvu nyume njɛ kfuu chi ŋgo yi fintaŋ fimi,
fi nyoonyi ajii fi fede biŋgogɛ bichii fɛnɛ fɛkuu muh gɛ̀ to wu nooŋ a wu mwɛne
yi ku, yi yɛɛŋ yi fe bite bichii bì ba nooŋ mwɛne, chɛ́ ye kuge yi nyaa kiyiŋ, munyii mù fuune we joone yeh a kiyiŋ kiyu le.”

content: Le no Jiso gɛ̀ feeji jɛ yi Nyo bamii le a baŋgaŋ le njɛ banɛ, no taŋlo bo yu bo gɛɛŋ bo bu.
Gɛ wu gɛ jɛme fiɛɛ bo le njɛ le a ŋgaŋ le sɛŋ gɛ. Geenɛ, wu gɛ̀ doo wu nyume bɛ booŋ be ba ŋgoo lɛbolɛbo, wu mo wu mɛsɛ wu bwaashɛ baŋgaŋ bayu bachii bo le.
Jiso waŋ nfuŋ
Jiso yɛyɛ bamii abvu, lɛ doo nyume fɛnfu, wu jɛmɛ booŋ be ba ŋgoo le lɛ,

content.text: “Bee daŋ mamasi bee gɛɛŋ wuŋ kwege.”

content: Bo mo bo chinɛ kinchvu ki bamii kì gɛ̀ bee fo le, bo lee a ŋguh wù Jiso gɛ̀ bee wa yo wɛɛ le, bɛ bo tu bo daŋe, baŋguh bamu bii bo le.
No bo gɛ̀ daŋe, nfuŋ wù baaŋ ja wu jaŋɛ wu kɛ wu tu wu muuse joo, joo lese a ŋguh le yi goone ki yi yîsɛ yo.
Jiso gɛ̀ bee a ŋguh wɛɛ jiŋ wu lefe, wu giŋsɛ kikwɛɛ yi mbwaaŋ le. Bo gɛɛŋ bo kaŋsɛ wu bo du lɛ, “Muh wu N'yɛyɛ, kwe goone ki yi jô besabɛŋ wo ghaade gɛ?”
Jiso kaŋsɛ, wu waŋ nfuŋ wuyu, wu jɛmɛ joo le lɛ,

content.text: “Wo nyûme nshiiŋŋ.”

content: Nfuŋ wuyu mo wu lu, manjuu chii nɛ nshiiŋŋ.
Wu mo wu biih booŋ be ba ŋgoo le lɛ,

content.text: “Bɛŋ faane la? Bɛŋ baaŋ a leesɛ gɛ fitele yi ye yaŋ le gɛ?”

content: Ye kuufɛ bo, bo tu bo ghaade fɛwɛɛwe lɛbolɛbo lɛ, “Wunɛ muh le wù nɛɛ, wù nfuŋ bɛ joo yuge wu le?”

footnotes.text: Fintaŋ finɛ le a jɛ́ yi bala le lɛ, “mustard”.
